svg.text: Agents read and propose. Only the harness executor writes, after policy and a person approve, and it reads every write back.
signature checked, normalised, de-duplicated, audited, then an Inngest event
restock, vendor reply, execute approved proposals, sync
a run waiting for approval survives restarts; each write is one memoised step
read tools and propose tools only; no agent can write or approve
structured outputs, so the workflow around them stays deterministic
packages/harness, plain code: the only path to a write
exact change as a field-level diff
read back and compare to the diff
Real services are a config change.
models behind every agent, prompt caching
About 20 scenarios run the real agents against the emulators: lab-test veto, prompt injection, partial shipment, rate-limit storms, undo.
Model calls are recorded once and replayed, so CI runs them offline for free.
